author: Poyri
body:
Hey Dear Staff Members!
It's been so long time that I'm still banned. I have learnt what's wrong, what's true in this time. I missed Avicus so much. So please unban me. I really missed Avicus and it's been so long time that I haven't played this server. I won't do same mistakes again, promise...

Thanks, Bora
